# Isolde Duckett & Nell Harcourt

- [Isolde Duckett](../character/isolde-duckett.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — close friends exchanging affection before a wedding · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Wedding P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003), [v3 ch.Wedding P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004), [v3 ch.Wedding P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) helps Isolde dress and prepare for her wedding day at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill). Following the ceremony and celebration, Hugh accompanies [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on a evening stroll back toward [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), taking a detour down Lovers' Lane to chat about their lives.
